messages.subject: More Shiny Module Problems
parts:
Seems that every step is like slogging through mud uphill, in driving rain and a headwind. Everything takes a special trick that is not part of normal R programming.

I made several more modules, most of which work, but this one I cannot resolve.

I want to populate  a selection list dynamically, based on a radiobutton selection.  In the simple example, I have represented the radioButton answer with the variable 'type'.

'type' is used to create a list of items that should populate the list.  IN this case there should be two items in the SelectInput object based on type = Table.

The print statement shows that I am correctly making the list.  I just cannot seem to get it to pass to the Selection List using updateSelectInput.

Here is my simple example that shows the empty SelectInput object:

How can I get this to work?

# ------------------------------------ MODULE ----------------------------------
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# module UI

CharOptionInput <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  tagList(
    br(),
    br(),
    selectInput(ns("charact"),
                label = "Characteristics:",
                choices = unlist(c(""))
    )
  )
}

# module server for PNC Text Input

CharOption <- function(input, output, session, PODData, category) {
 
  cnamelist <- function(PODData,category) {
    ifelse(list(category) == c("Table"),
           list(PODData$Characteristic[PODData$Feature== c("Table")]),
           list(PODData$Characteristic[PODData$Feature == "Chair"])
                  )
  }
 
 
  print(cnamelist(PODData,category))
  choices <- cnamelist(PODData,category)
  vars <- all.vars(parse(text=as.character(choices)))
  vars <- as.list(vars)
  updateSelectInput(session, "charact", choices = vars)
 
  return(list(
    Charact = reactive({input$charact})
  ))
}

# ----------------------------------- MAIN APP ---------------------------------
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

library(shiny)

Historical <- tibble::tibble(
  Feature = c("Table", "Table", "Chair", "Chair"),
  Characteristic = c(
    "Length",
    "Width",
    "Height",
    "Depth"
  )
)

ui <- fluidPage(
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(),
    mainPanel(CharOptionInput("char1"))
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
 
  type <- "Table"
 
  results <- callModule(CharOption, "char1", PODData = Historical, category = type)
 
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: More Shiny Module Problems
parts:
When you call callModule(CharOption, ...), don't pass category = results2(). Instead, do category = results2, and inside CharOption server function, do category() when you want to retrieve a value.

Think of it this way. When calling a module or function, passing category() means "pass the current value of category", while passing category means "pass the reactive expression itself", or alternatively, "pass all future values of category".
